scope: All earlier Blog and Research plus current cross-family batch
decision: passed; no substantive collision requires rewriting
method: Compared every item against the full earlier Blog and Research corpus and against the other 16 items in the current cross-family batch. The recorded topic, core argument, worked example, retained authority, and intended reader decision were the substantive tests. Lexical slug and prose comparison were used only to surface candidates and were not treated as proof.
